reason: I only cook on weekends and I already ask my free AI app for any recipe I want, so a list of 14 dishes plus one a week gives me less than what I have now. The two free dishes are kra pao and khai jiao, which I can make without looking, so there is nothing to hook me before it asks me to subscribe.
objection: Only two dishes, and I already know both. I'd run out after two dinners and never see why this beats asking my AI for free. And I don't want another auto-renewing subscription I have to remember to cancel, just for a weekend hobby.
would_change_my_mind: Let me cook one of the hard dishes, like green curry from paste, free without starting a subscription. If it clearly comes out better than what my AI tells me, 99 baht is nothing.
